description.value:
You conjure a fully sensory illusory image—sight, sound, and more—no larger than a 20-foot cube, appearing at a location you can see and lasting for the duration; it cannot deal damage or impose conditions.

While within range, you may spend your action to relocate the image anywhere else in range, adjusting its motion so it looks natural. Physical contact betrays the illusion, and a creature can spend its action to identify it as false with a successful Investigation check; once discovered, that creature sees through the image and perceives its other sensory effects as faint.

Overcharge Tech. Cast using a 6th-level slot or higher, the illusion persists until dispelled and no longer requires concentration.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
